items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: I took it up to Claude before I took it down to Fletcher.

ctx.x: For this reason -- when I finished copied the arrangement, and I got in my own score at that time. I wasn't able to have a copyist it copied, you know. I took it up to Claude before I took it down to Fletcher. And his band could read and everything, and, man, they went wild over the thing. and so he said, "Hey, I want this." Well, I says, "Well, okay. pass it in. I'll bring it back, you know, something. I was
on my way down to the Roseland, you know, to take it to Fletcher (Unintelligible) anyway. This is what happened.
